parts.1:
Questions 1–5

1 Where are the boy’s jeans now?

Boy: Mum, where are my jeans? I left them in my bedroom.

Mum: I know – they were on the floor! Please can you keep them in the wardrobe, not on the floor? I’m washing them now, they were dirty.

Boy: Oh. If they’re still in the washing machine, I can’t wear them.

Mum: That’s right – just choose something else from your wardrobe.

Boy: OK.

2 Where’s the girl’s phone?

Girl: Dad? Have you seen my phone?

Dad: Did you leave it in the bathroom again when you went to the toilet?

Girl: I’ve already checked there. And I’ve looked under the sofa… Oh! It’s OK. You can stop looking now!

Dad: Oh good, where was it?

Girl: Next to the window, but it was behind the curtain, so I couldn’t see it.

3 What did the boy do for his neighbour?

Boy: I was helping my neighbour in her garden yesterday. And she paid me!

Girl: Cool! What were you doing? Looking after flowers?

Boy: No, she does all that. There’s an old gate. She wanted someone to paint it, so she asked me.

Girl: Couldn’t she do it herself?

Boy: Usually she does, but she hurt her back when she was cutting the grass.

4 What did the girl break?

Girl: I broke something while I was playing football at home yesterday.

Boy: Did you kick the ball and hit a window?

Girl: Well, nearly. My mum left some plates on the table in the garden. But when I kicked the ball and it hit the table, they all fell and broke.

Boy: At least that’s not as expensive as breaking a window!

5 What will be the pupils’ first lesson tomorrow?

Girl: Have we got geography tomorrow morning?

Boy: Yes, we have. It’s the second lesson of the day, after chemistry.

Girl: Oh, are you sure? I thought maths was our first lesson.

Boy: That’s on Thursday. But tomorrow’s Friday.

Girl: Oh that’s good. I don’t really like starting the day with maths!
parts.2:
Questions 6–10

Rosie: Hi, it’s Rosie. Look, would you like to go for a bike ride? We could do it on 28th June. School finishes on June 27th, so it’ll be our first day of holidays!

We don’t need to start too early, so not nine o’clock like on school days, so what about ten-thirty instead?

We can cycle along the river, and go all the way to the lake. Then we can turn round and come back the same way. There won’t be any traffic if we go that way, just other bikes.

Why don’t we start at Henrietta Park? That’s H-E-N-R-I-E double-T-A.

And another thing – you know there’ll be lots of wild flowers at this time of year, well, I want to take pictures of the bees that visit them. We can use our phones to take photos.

Oh, and I have a new phone number – it’s 07 double 6 823901. See you soon!
parts.3:
Questions 11–15

Joe: Hi Emily, you missed English. Were you at the doctor’s?

Emily: Actually, I’m learning the violin. And my class was at the same time as English.

Joe: Oh.

Emily: But I forgot to tell the teacher.

Joe: Oh, we started reading Thunderstorm.

Emily: Oh, that play where a king left his castle and his ship was in a thunderstorm, and they got to this island.

Joe: Exactly, and stay there for the whole play.

Emily: Are you enjoying it?

Joe: Well, I loved our last topic, and I thought an old play might be boring. And hard. But guess what – I was wrong! It’s not, and I really want to know what happens.

Emily: Amazing – you’re a theatre fan, Joe!

Joe: Exactly! The teacher said Thunderstorm is the only play the man wrote.

Emily: Shame. I’ve never seen it. Thunderstorm is at the theatre in town.

Joe: You know what our class should do? Do the play ourselves!

Emily: What, us acting?

Joe: Yeah! I’ll be the king!

Emily: That’d be fun!

Joe: Yeah!

Emily: Is the homework online?

Joe: Actually, it’s a group project. The teacher put us in groups, so the other members of yours should email you and let you know about it.
parts.4:
Questions 16–20

16 You will hear a boy leaving a message for his sister. Why does he say he’s sorry?

Boy: Hi, it’s me. Look, I’m really sorry, but I told you the film starts at 6.30. Well, I got that wrong I’m afraid, it’s 7:30. My mistake. Hopefully you can still meet me like we said, but look, if that’s too late, and we need to cancel, then that’s OK, I understand.

17 You will hear a woman phoning a department store. Why is she phoning?

Man: Customer service. How can I help?

Woman: Hello, I bought an alarm clock. It was 35 euros, reduced from 90, I think, but I’m sure you can check that. Anyway, I’m not happy with it.

Man: Is there anything wrong with it?

Woman: That’s not the point. I have 28 days to send it back if I want, right? I’d like to do that.

Man: That’s fine.

18 You will hear a boy in a clothes shop. What does he want the shop assistant to do?

Boy: Excuse me, I can’t see a label on this jacket. I think it’s large – is that right?

Girl: Shall I check for you? Oh – it’s extra large. It’s our largest size.

Boy: Cool, that’s my size. I do like it… but it is a lot of money. Could you let me have a discount, do you think?

Girl: I’ll have to ask the manager.

19 You will hear a girl talking about a party she went to. What is she surprised about?

Girl: I went to a party at my classmate Rick’s house. He’s a lovely guy, but really shy. He had such a lot of guests there, I was amazed. I had a brilliant time, but then I always do at parties. Nothing new there. Everyone said the band was awesome. I don’t understand why – their songs were quite annoying actually!

20 You will hear a hotel guest phoning the receptionist. What is the problem?

Woman: Reception. How may I help?

Man: Hello, I’m in room 425. It’s hard to sleep in the room because I can hear water coming through my heater all the time.

Woman: Is it too warm?

Man: It’s not that, it’s all the noise the water heater makes. It’s keeping me awake. Could I have a different room? Even with a smaller bed, a single room.

Woman: OK.
parts.5:
Questions 21–25

Father: Can you check the weather on your phone? I know tomorrow there’ll be a lot of cloud.

Daughter: Yeah. That’s right.

Father: What about Monday? I have to drive a long way for a business trip.

Daughter: It’ll be foggy all day.

Father: Oh dear, that’s not good for driving.

Daughter: Isn’t rain worse?

Father: Maybe. But I don’t mind if there’s rain on Tuesday.

Daughter: Actually, it’s going to be dry and bright all day.

Father: Oh no, the sun’ll be out when I’m working. Why can’t it just snow?

Daughter: Hmm, good question. On Wednesday, there’ll be a lot of wind.

Father: Oh – so you could go surfing after school. Except the water might be cold if you fall in.

Daughter: True. When are you coming back?

Father: Thursday, so I’d like some normal weather if possible – not foggy, not too wet.

Daughter: Actually, the temperature’s going to be very low then.

Father: Oh, perhaps I’ll go by train if there’s ice.

Daughter: Yeah. That sounds like a good idea.

Father: And I’m free on Friday, so I suppose there’ll be rain, and lots of it.

Daughter: I’m afraid so.

Father: Oh well, perhaps my next day off will be nice and sunny instead!

explanations.p1q1: 男孩找不到牛仔裤，妈妈说"I’m washing them now, they were dirty"，男孩担心"If they’re still in the washing machine, I can’t wear them"，妈妈只让他"just choose something else from your wardrobe"，可见牛仔裤现在正在洗衣机里——是厨房里那台洗衣机，不是浴室里那台，因此选择 A。
explanations.p1q2: 爸爸猜手机又落在浴室里，女孩说"I’ve already checked there"，最后她自己找到了："Next to the window, but it was behind the curtain, so I couldn’t see it"，可见手机就在窗户边、窗帘后面，被窗帘挡住了所以刚才没看见，因此选择 A。
explanations.p1q3: 男孩说他昨天帮邻居打理花园还拿到了报酬，"There’s an old gate. She wanted someone to paint it, so she asked me"，可见邻居家的院门旧了，她想找人刷漆就请他帮忙，他已经把门漆好了，因此选择 A；女孩猜他在照看花，男孩说"No, she does all that"，浇花都是邻居自己做的。
explanations.p1q4: 女孩说"My mum left some plates on the table in the garden. But when I kicked the ball and it hit the table, they all fell and broke."，可见碎掉的是花园桌子上的一叠盘子，因此选择 B；男孩猜她踢球打中了窗户，她说"Well, nearly"，窗户并没有碎。
explanations.p1q5: 男孩说地理是"the second lesson of the day, after chemistry"，即化学是明天的第一节课，因此选择 C；女孩以为第一节是数学，男孩说"That’s on Thursday. But tomorrow’s Friday."，数学是周四的课。
explanations.p2q1: 正确答案是 10:30。Rosie 说不用像上学日那么早出发，"so not nine o’clock like on school days, so what about ten-thirty instead?"，即集合时间是十点半；九点是被她否定的上学日出发时间，不要误填。
explanations.p2q2: 正确答案是 lake。Rosie 说"We can cycle along the river, and go all the way to the lake"，骑行的终点是湖；河只是沿途骑行的路线，不要误填 river。
explanations.p2q3: 正确答案是 Henrietta。Rosie 说"Why don’t we start at Henrietta Park? That’s H-E-N-R-I-E double-T-A."，并逐字拼读公园名确认拼写，集合地点就是 Henrietta Park。
explanations.p2q4: 正确答案是 bees。Rosie 说这个季节野花很多，"I want to take pictures of the bees that visit them"，她想拍的是落在野花上的蜜蜂，野花只是背景，不要误填 flowers。
explanations.p2q5: 正确答案是 0766823901。Rosie 说"I have a new phone number – it’s 07 double 6 823901"，"double 6"表示连续两个 6，即 0766823901。
explanations.p3q1: Joe 猜 Emily 是去看病，她回答"Actually, I’m learning the violin. And my class was at the same time as English."，可见她正在学小提琴，小提琴课和英语课时间冲突所以缺课，因此选择 C；她只是"forgot to tell the teacher"（忘了向老师请假），并不是忘了有课。
explanations.p3q2: Emily 复述剧情说国王离开城堡后"his ship was in a thunderstorm, and they got to this island"，Joe 说"Exactly, and stay there for the whole play"，可见故事发生在乘船抵达的一座岛上，因此选择 C；城堡只是国王离开的地方，不是剧情发生地。
explanations.p3q3: Joe 说"I thought an old play might be boring. And hard. But guess what – I was wrong!"，还"really want to know what happens"，可见这部老剧本远比他预想的有趣，他对此感到意外，因此选择 A；他喜欢的是上一个话题，而且他明确说"It’s not"（不无聊也不难）。
explanations.p3q4: Joe 提议"Do the play ourselves!"，Emily 先问"What, us acting?"，听到 Joe 说"I’ll be the king!"后回应"That’d be fun!"，可见两人都愿意自己出演这部剧，因此选择 A；Emily 只是说自己"I’ve never seen it"，去镇上剧院看剧并非两人的约定。
explanations.p3q5: Emily 问"Is the homework online?"，Joe 回答"Actually, it’s a group project. The teacher put us in groups, so the other members of yours should email you and let you know about it."，可见作业不在网上，而是同小组的同学会发邮件告诉 Emily，因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q1: 男孩留言说"I’m really sorry, but I told you the film starts at 6.30. Well, I got that wrong I’m afraid, it’s 7:30."，可见他道歉是因为之前把电影开始时间说错了，即给了姐姐错误的信息，因此选择 C；他还说"you can still meet me like we said"，见面照旧，也不是要取消。
explanations.p4q2: 男士问钟"Is there anything wrong with it?"，女士说"That’s not the point. I have 28 days to send it back if I want, right? I’d like to do that."，可见钟本身没坏，她是要在 28 天退货期内把闹钟退掉，因此选择 B；她也不是去核对有没有付对价钱。
explanations.p4q3: 男孩说"Could you let me have a discount, do you think?"，店员回答"I’ll have to ask the manager."，可见他想请店员帮忙打个折，即给出更便宜的价格，因此选择 B；尺码他已经满意（"Cool, that’s my size"），不需要更大的码。
explanations.p4q4: 她说害羞的 Rick 家"He had such a lot of guests there, I was amazed"，让她吃惊的是客人特别多，因此选择 A；玩得开心是她的常态（"I always do at parties. Nothing new there"），乐队人人夸好但她觉得歌"quite annoying actually"，都不令她意外。
explanations.p4q5: 他说"It’s hard to sleep in the room because I can hear water coming through my heater all the time."，并强调"It’s keeping me awake"，可见问题是暖气的水声太吵、房间不够安静，因此选择 C；他主动提出"Even with a smaller bed, a single room"也行，床的大小不是问题，暖气也没有坏。
explanations.p5q1: 爸爸要开车出远门，问女儿周一的天气，女儿说"It’ll be foggy all day."，爸爸也抱怨"that’s not good for driving"，可见周一是雾天，即 fog。
explanations.p5q2: 爸爸说"I don’t mind if there’s rain on Tuesday."，女儿纠正说"Actually, it’s going to be dry and bright all day."，爸爸还感叹"the sun’ll be out when I’m working"，可见周二全天晴朗，即 sunny。
explanations.p5q3: 女儿说"On Wednesday, there’ll be a lot of wind."，爸爸还打趣说她放学后可以去冲浪，可见周三风很大，即 windy。
explanations.p5q4: 爸爸希望回程那天"not foggy, not too wet"，女儿说"Actually, the temperature’s going to be very low then."，爸爸担心路面结冰想改坐火车，可见周四气温很低、会很冷，即 cold。
explanations.p5q5: 爸爸猜周五"there’ll be rain, and lots of it"，女儿回应"I’m afraid so."，可见周五确实会下大雨，即 wet。

conflicts: p2q3: 站内数据 answer 为 hartley/Hartley，与文稿矛盾——Rosie 逐字拼读 "That’s H-E-N-R-I-E double-T-A"，即 Henrietta Park。officialAnswers 按文稿填 Henrietta，请主会话核对并更正站内数据。
p5q1: 站内数据 answer=4（sunny/E），与文稿矛盾——Monday 为 "It’ll be foggy all day."（fog/C）；站内解析所述"太阳会回来、很棒的一天"不在本套文稿中，疑与其他套数据串套。officialAnswers 按文稿填 C。
p5q2: 站内数据 answer=7（windy/H），与文稿矛盾——Tuesday 为 "Actually, it’s going to be dry and bright all day."（sunny/E）；站内解析所述"风筝比赛"不在本套文稿中。officialAnswers 按文稿填 E。
p5q3: 站内数据 answer=2（fog/C），与文稿矛盾——Wednesday 为 "On Wednesday, there’ll be a lot of wind."（windy/H）；站内解析所述"骑行"不在本套文稿中。officialAnswers 按文稿填 H。
p4q1/p4q2: 站内解析细节与文稿不符——p4q1 称正确时间"其实是 5:30"，文稿为 "it’s 7:30"；p4q2 称"闹铃坏了"，但女士明确说 "That’s not the point"（钟没毛病）。两题解析已按文稿更正，答案（C/B）不变。
uncertain: p2: 文本层原作 "it’ll be out first day of holidays"，按语法与上下文判读转写为 "our first day of holidays"。
p4q4(第19题): 文本层题干原作 "suprised"，按上下文转写为 "surprised"。
